entries.zh: 昏暗依稀难辨；迷茫（茫：模糊不分明）
entries.en: dark and barely discernible; hazy, vast and indistinct

entries.zh: 雾；昏暗如雾，视界迷茫
entries.en: fog, mist; dark and barely visible as in fog

entries.zh: 昏昧不明；不识、不知（西文例句"彼处我不认得"）
entries.en: dim, obscure; not to know, unacquainted with ("there I do not know/recognize it")

entries.zh: 昏暗不清，如雾气弥漫（字或作"暝"，取昏黑之义）
entries.en: dark, not clear, as if there were mist
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑[暝/寐]，释义以西文定义"oscuro no claro como que hay niebla"为主。

entries.zh: 昏暗（如傍晚天色）；黄昏、天色向晚
entries.en: dark as at eventide; dusk, dim

entries.zh: 乌阴，天色阴沉昏暗
entries.en: dark and overcast, gloomy (of the sky)

entries.zh: 茫雾，迷茫浓雾（喻昏暗不辨物）
entries.en: misty, blinding fog; dense fog obscuring the view

entries.zh: 含糊，言语或意思模糊不清
entries.en: vague, indistinct, ambiguous (of speech or meaning)

entries.zh: 阴暗，幽暗不明
entries.en: dark, gloomy, dim

entries.zh: 影影，隐约如影、依稀一影（"影影尔"：恍惚有影）
entries.en: shadowy, faint as a shadow ("shadow upon shadow")
entries.notes: 末字"年"疑为"爾（尔）"之转写，官话栏"sombra y sombra"确证"影影"之义。

entries.zh: 昏乱，神志昏惑不明
entries.en: confused, muddled; mentally dark and disordered
entries.notes: 西文定义截断（"en la racon"或为 en la razón，心思之义），"墨亂"组合罕见，据 obscuro 语境拟测。

entries.zh: 昏暗，光线不明
entries.en: dark, dim, obscure

entries.zh: 昏昧，昏暗不明；亦指愚昧昏聩
entries.en: dim, obscure; dull, ignorant

entries.zh: 幽暗，幽深昏暗
entries.en: dark, dim, gloomy (deep and dark)

entries.zh: 乌暗，漆黑昏暗
entries.en: pitch-dark, jet-black darkness

entries.zh: 一阵昏暗，短暂轻微的一小段昏暗
entries.en: a brief slight darkness; a short spell of dimness
entries.notes: 西文缩写密集（peqña/larque/mte/tpt´）展开属推断；"一小阵昏暗"据 Obscuridad pequeña 与"一X暗"结构拟定。

entries.zh: 暗雨，落雨时天色昏暗
entries.en: darkness as of rain; dark rain (rain making the sky dark)
entries.notes: 汉字存疑[雨/两]；西文"delucia"疑为 de luvia（雨）转写之讹，与"暗雨"义相合。

entries.zh: 孝男，居丧戴孝、主持丧祭之子
entries.en: mourning son, the filial son who conducts the funeral rites (exequias)
entries.notes: 西文缩写（pt./f./hunra os≈honras、en texar）展开属推断；孝男与 Obsequias/honras 丧礼义相合。

entries.zh: 守，遵守、持守（诫命、法度）
entries.en: to keep, observe; observance (of precepts or rules)
entries.notes: 闽南语栏记号污损难辨（T99）故列低置信；语义据守/Obseruancia 四栏仍清晰。

entries.zh: 守善，持守善德、遵行德性
entries.en: to keep/observe virtue; adherence to goodness
entries.notes: 闽南语栏首字记号污损难辨（T99）故列低置信；语义据守善/obseruancia de la virtud 清晰。
